title: DOJ charges illegal voters from three states in 2022 and 2024 elections
text:
The Department of Justice on Friday announced charges against five individuals for illegally voting or helping someone illegally register to vote in the 2022 and 2024 elections in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and Wisconsin.

The case includes two people whom federal prosecutors identify as illegal immigrants, two other noncitizens, and one U.S. citizen accused of helping his wife illegally register and vote, according to the DOJ.
